description: Is this company worth contacting FOR YOU? Everything in company-enrich, plus a fit verdict for your offer and goal: good / maybe / poor, a 0-100 score, reasons grounded in facts from the company's website, and an opening line that references one of those facts. Input: domain or name, plus for: { seller (who you are and what you sell), goal (sales | partnership | supplier | hiring | investment | other), optional ideal_customer }. No website found = no charge. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/company-fit with an x402 client.
